Athens Robotics Challenge 2027

Organised by Athena Robotics Lab

In person at Technopolis, Athens, Greece.

The challenge takes place February 20 - 22, 2027, starting 09:00 on day one and ending 18:00 on February 22.

Participation is by application: teams are selected by the organisers.

Applications close January 31, 2027 at 23:59 (Athens time). Selected teams are notified by February 10, 2027.

Apply here

Participation fee: none. Open to university students.

Travel grants: up to €300 for teams from outside Attica.
